fullPassage: The prominence of the social dimension in food writing might suggest that the flavor of food is taking a back seat. I suspect that most people view flavor as of secondary importance in social settings where food is served. Although our social gatherings coalesce around food, the meaning of these gatherings does not seem to depend on flavor. Flavor assists with the narrow purpose of filling the belly, and once that is accomplished it provides the backdrop for whatever social dynamics characterize the gathering. These can be understood independently of the flavor of the food on offer, the appreciation of which is understood to be personal and subjective. According to this conventional wisdom, the ceremonies and rituals around food, the social events that supply food with its meaning, does not depend on the quality of sensations provided by the food. To focus excessively on flavor is to miss the larger significance of these social relations.

det.korean: 명사 convention(관습, 관례)을 형용사형 conventional(전통적인)으로 변환. wisdom을 수식하므로 형용사가 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ conventional: convention(명사) → conventional(형용사). 명사 wisdom 수식에 형용사 필요
det.tip: convention(명사: 관습) → conventional(형용사: 전통적인, 관례적인)

questions.passage: These can be understood __________ (independent) of the flavor of the food on offer, the appreciation of which is understood to be personal and subjective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 형용사 independent(독립적인)를 부사형 independently(독립적으로)로 변환. 동사 understood를 수식하므로 부사가 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ independently: independent(형용사) → independently(부사). 동사 수식에 부사 필요
det.tip: independent(형용사) → independently(부사) → independence(명사)

questions.passage: The prominence of the social dimension in food writing might suggest that the flavor of food is taking a back seat. I suspect that most people view flavor as of secondary importance in social settings where food is served. Although our social gatherings coalesce around food, the meaning of these gatherings does not seem to depend on flavor. Flavor assists with the narrow purpose of filling the belly, and once that is accomplished it provides the backdrop for whatever social dynamics characterize the gathering. These can be understood independently of the flavor of the food on offer, the appreciation of which is understood to be personal and subjective. According to this __________, the ceremonies and rituals around food, the social events that supply food with its meaning, does not depend on the quality of sensations provided by the food. To focus excessively on flavor is to miss the larger significance of these social relations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 전통적 통념(conventional wisdom)에 따르면 의식과 의례는 감각의 질에 의존하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① social dynamics(사회적 역학): 본문에 나오나 이 빈칸에는 맞지 않음
❌ ② secondary importance(부차적 중요성): 본문에 나오나 이 빈칸에는 맞지 않음
❌ ③ personal experience(개인 경험): 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ conventional wisdom(전통적 통념): 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: conventional wisdom = 전통적 통념, 일반적 통설. conventional(전통적) + wisdom(지혜)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 맛에 과도하게 집중하면 사회적 관계의 더 큰 의미(the larger significance)를 놓친다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the narrow purpose(좁은 목적): 본문에 나오나 이 빈칸에는 맞지 않음
❌ ② the secondary importance(부차적 중요성): 본문에 나오나 이 빈칸에는 맞지 않음
✅ ③ the larger significance(더 큰 의미): 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ the social dimension(사회적 차원): 본문에 나오나 이 빈칸에는 맞지 않음
det.tip: significance = importance = 중요성, 의미. miss the larger significance = 더 큰 의미를 놓치다
